default_rule: If no rule above matches, keep a low-cost curve: prefer keeping 1-2 cost cards when the hand lacks early plays; otherwise replace. 3+ cost cards are thrown unless the hand already has a 1-2 curve.
notes: keep_if_coin applies when going second (the extra mana lets us curve into 2-cost cards).
keep_curve_filler only applies when the hand already has an early play (has_early in code).
